step_pair.title: Pair any host in seconds
step_pair.subtitle: Scan a code, you're in
step_pair.description: Install the agent on Linux, macOS, or a Pi, run `pocketshell pair`, and scan the QR or type the code. ED25519 keys, end-to-end via WebRTC — your terminal traffic never touches our servers.
step_terminal.title: A real terminal, anywhere
step_terminal.subtitle: Full PTY, not a toy
step_terminal.description: Ctrl chords, arrow keys, tab completion, search, and clipboard. Attach to tmux or screen, edit in vim, drive long-running deploys — from a coffee shop or the back of a cab.
step_workspaces.title: A workspace per project
step_workspaces.subtitle: Tabs, files, all in one
step_workspaces.description: Group terminals and a file browser into named workspaces. Browse, view, and transfer files between phone and host. Switch projects without losing your place.
step_monitor.title: Watch your fleet, get paged
step_monitor.subtitle: Live stats & smart alerts
step_monitor.description: Live CPU, memory, disk, and network with per-process drill-down. Set thresholds and get push notifications the moment something goes sideways.
